name: ecommerce_surface
description: Ecommerce hero and PDP: subject-first hero, module order, sparse badges
when_to_use: Ecommerce / 电商 / PDP / 商详 / product hero / 详情页 / shopping hero — product-led surfaces (not generic SaaS dashboard)
prompt_negative: Do not invent prices/discounts/SKU; do not bury the product under chrome; do not turn PDP into a festive poster with no modules; never leave uncut white product plates on the board.
